records.body: How do I reset the password for a teammate who no longer has access to their old email?

records.subject: Re: Password reset
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for your patience on this. Easiest fix: an admin can resend an invite, or remove and re-invite, a teammate who lost access to their email.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Lantern Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: your teammate's email access
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for the ticket about resetting a teammate's password when they've lost access to their old email -- it's still open with our team, and I'm keeping an eye on it. One thing that may unblock you right away: an admin can resend an invite, or remove and re-invite, a teammate who lost access to their email.

It was good talking last week, and glad another person is in the workspace with you. Want me to walk through that re-invite with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
